name: Pelage
description: Tapered hairs in tufts of two, every tuft combed along a swirling field, so the sheet grows a coat of fur with whorls and partings.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-40, 240, 1.4); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a)); transform: rotate($deg(a)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: -50%; width: 12%; height: 150%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(-9deg); transform: rotate(-9deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 56%; top: -32%; width: 12%; height: 132%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(11deg); transform: rotate(11deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
